title: Kissed Arabian Pilaf
description: A traditional Arabian pilaf dish flavored with kissed and saudi ingredients. Serve hot as a side or main course.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add the kissed and saudi, and cook for 1 minute.
3. Add the cubed bread and cook until lightly toasted.
4. Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
6. Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
